task_language: put the black bowl on top of the cabinet

subtasks.name: pick(black_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: failed: rim grasp at ~60-67 tilts the bowl, which slips back to the table by 73; no retry

subtasks.name: place(black_bowl, cabinet_top, on)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted with the bowl: the empty gripper hovers over the cabinet top and handles from ~113 to 409

behaviour_summary: pi0 descended on the bowl, closed on its rim and started lifting; the bowl tipped and slipped out (67-73). The empty gripper then went to the cabinet and hovered over its top/top handle until timeout.

failures.mode_definition: The gripper closes on an object's rim or edge; when the lift starts the object tilts, slips out and falls back to the table.
failures.rl_success_check: black bowl lifted clear of the table (> 5 cm) and still in the closed gripper 1 s later
failures.observation: Step 53 gripper above the bowl, open; 60 fingers down at the bowl rim; 67 bowl tilted strongly (one side raised by the rim grasp); 73 bowl back flat on the table, fingers above it; 80-93 gripper rises empty.

failures.mode_definition: After a failed grasp the policy gives up on the object and moves to (and idles at) a destination-like location with an empty gripper instead of re-grasping.
hl_remedy: VERIFY(gripper empty, bowl on table, zoom)
INVOKE_RL(rl/pick_bowl) or REPROMPT('pick up the black bowl and place it on top of the cabinet')
failures.prevention: After each grasp attempt, VERIFY the object is in the gripper (zoom + gripper width) before letting pi0 continue to the destination.
failures.observation: After the slip pi0 never returns to the bowl: 107-127 it moves to the cabinet, and 133-409 it hovers with an empty, open gripper over the cabinet top near the top handle; no drawer moves.

notes: The bowl ends on the table, slightly displaced from its start. The cabinet hover is at roughly the right destination (top of the cabinet), which suggests the destination was understood but the missing object was not noticed.
